description: Create scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js by copying the collision-asserted engine from scripts/gen-diagram.js and generalizing its hardcoded 2-row/5-column grid to N rows / N columns driven by the content model, then swapping in a DPI 2 content model that KEEPS the full DPI 1 baseline (rows 0-1, 10 nodes, 4 zones, both side panels, gov strip, gray/neutral palette) and ADDS a third zone band (row 2) of 6 orange-accented DPI 2 proposal nodes (Cognito, DynamoDB-as-primary, DynamoDB Streams->Lambda Notifier, SNS+Slack/Teams, CloudWatch Synthetics+Route 53, Logs Insights+S3). Emit NEW files OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg and .png (never overwrite the DPI 1 files), add the npm script, and prove DPI 1 behaviour is unchanged. The engine's assertNoCollisions 13-rule gate must stay IDENTICAL and pass with 0 fails. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002's doc references the DPI 2 output filenames produced here.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-dpi2-diagram/context.json and this file FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration. Also read the full plan at .agents/tasks/dpi2-diagram-plan.md (sections 2, 3, 4, 7) for the exact content model, grid placement, and engine generalization.

Copy scripts/gen-diagram.js verbatim to scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js (new file). Update the /* header */ comment to name OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg and .png. Keep it self-contained CommonJS; do NOT modify the original gen-diagram.js.

Generalize the grid in the copy: derive COLS = max(NODES[].col) and ROWS = max(GROUPS[].row)+1; build rowPanelY and cardsY as length-ROWS arrays (row 0 as today, each later row = previous row's zone bottom + ROW_GUTTER_Y, cardsY[r] = rowPanelY[r] + TITLE_BAND_H); replace colX(5)/frameW with colX(COLS); change the two column-channel loops to 1..COLS and the inter-column gutter loop to 1..<COLS; add one full-width row-gutter channel per inter-row gap (ch-row{r}) so rule 13 passes for row-2 edges; set bodyBottom to the last body row's bottom. Keep side panels panel-app on row 0 and panel-users on row 1; row 2 has no side panel. Keep assertNoCollisions and all 13 rules byte-for-behaviour identical to DPI 1.

Swap in the DPI 2 content model per plan section 2: set TITLE_TEXT='URBANI "Radar UrbiNexus" — DPI 2 Target Architecture (PROPOSED)' and the DPI 2 SUBTITLE_TEXT; keep DPI 1 GROUPS zone-a..zone-d (existing fills) and ADD orange zones zone-e (row 2, cols [1,3]) and zone-f (row 2, cols [4,6]) with fill '#fff3e8', stroke '#E1701A', color '#9a4a06' and (PROPOSED ...) subtitles; keep DPI 1 NODES n1..n9+n-apigw and ADD 6 nodes d1..d6 (each with dpi2:true) placed d1=zone-e col1, d2=zone-e col2, d3=zone-e col3, d4=zone-f col4, d5=zone-f col5, d6=zone-f col6 with the titles/subs/detail lines in the plan table.

Add new <symbol> defs in this copy's DEFS for icons i-cognito, i-stream, i-sns, i-synth, i-logs (simple AWS-style rounded-tile glyphs in the same family as the existing hand-drawn icons; unique ids that do not shadow any DPI 1 symbol). Reuse existing i-ddb for d2.

Add DPI 2 EDGES per plan section 2.4: D1 d1->d2, D2 d2->d3, D3 d3->d4 (solid, label 'DynamoDB Streams → Notifier → SNS / Slack / Teams', labelAt gutter-above), D4 d4->d5, D5 d5->d6 (all h-row solid). Add cross-row D6 n7->d2 (v-col, dashed, label 'Persistence migrates SQLite → DynamoDB (PROPOSED)'). If D6 cannot route without a channel/collision failure, DROP D6 (it is illustrative) and rely on the zone-e subtitle + footnote.

Add the orange accent: in emitSvg, when a card's node has dpi2===true, render its stroke as '#E1701A' width 1.6 plus a 2px orange top rule inside the already-reserved card box (no new collision rects). Append a third LEGEND entry rendered as an orange swatch with text 'orange = DPI 2 proposal (validated at kickoff); Main/Payment ingestion depends on client access'. Append two orange GOV_TILES ('Cognito — SSO/MFA' / '4 RBAC roles (PROPOSED)' and 'SNS + Slack/Teams' / 'alerts, dedup (PROPOSED)'). Append one DPI 2 honesty FOOTNOTE stating the orange services are NOT yet deployed, DPI 1 delivered SQLite + un-deployed CDK scaffolding, and pointing to docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md.

Set the output file names in main() to OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg and .png; keep RASTER_W=5400 (density auto-derives). Ensure the DPI 1 file names are NEVER written by this script.

Iterate: run node scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js --dry-run; if any collision or channel (rule 13) failure prints, adjust the offending node's col/zone span or drop D6, and re-run until it prints '0 collisions' and exits 0.
Add "gen:diagram:dpi2": "node scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js" to package.json scripts, immediately after the "gen:diagram" line, without reordering other scripts.
Run npm run gen:diagram:dpi2 to write the two DPI 2 output files.

Record in this FEAT's findings the final node count, whether D6 was kept or dropped, the canvas dimensions printed, and confirmation that the DPI 1 outputs were untouched. Set this FEAT's status to completed.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js exists, is self-contained CommonJS, and does not modify scripts/gen-diagram.js.
Running `node scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js --dry-run` prints '0 collisions' and exits 0 (assertNoCollisions reports zero fails), with the full DPI 1 baseline plus the 6 DPI 2 nodes present.
Running `npm run gen:diagram:dpi2` writes OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg and OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.png and exits 0.
`node --test scripts/gen-diagram.test.js` still passes 11/11, and `node scripts/gen-diagram.js --dry-run` still prints '0 collisions' with 10 nodes, exit 0 (DPI 1 behaviour unchanged).

The DPI 2 diagram visually distinguishes DPI 1 baseline (gray/neutral) from DPI 2 additions (orange accent) and carries the honesty legend note + PROPOSED zone subtitles + the not-yet-deployed footnote.
package.json contains the "gen:diagram:dpi2" script next to "gen:diagram".
verification: node scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js --dry-run   (expect: '0 collisions', exit 0, DPI 2 node count = 16)
node scripts/gen-diagram.js --dry-run         (expect: '0 collisions', nodes 10, exit 0 — DPI 1 unchanged)
npm run gen:diagram:dpi2                        (expect: writes the two DPI 2 OUTPUT files, exit 0)
Compare OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram.svg/.png LastWriteTime before and after (expect: unchanged)
findings: Implemented scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js as a self-contained CommonJS copy of the gen-diagram.js engine, generalized from a hardcoded 2-row/5-column grid to N rows / N columns derived from the content model (COLS=max(NODES.col)=6, ROWS=max(GROUPS.row)+1=3), with per-inter-row-gutter channels (ch-row1, ch-row2) and the 13-rule assertNoCollisions gate kept behaviour-identical. Final node count: 16 (10 DPI 1 baseline n1-n9+n-apigw in gray/neutral + 6 DPI 2 orange-accent nodes d1 Cognito, d2 DynamoDB-primary, d3 DynamoDB Streams+Notifier, d4 SNS+Slack/Teams, d5 CloudWatch Synthetics, d6 CloudWatch Logs Insights). Edge D6 (n7 row-1 -> d2 row-2) was DROPPED per plan sec 2.4: it is a cross-COLUMN row-1->row-2 link (n7 col 4, d2 col 2) and the v-col shape requires a shared column, so it has no clean orthogonal route inside a reserved channel; the SQLite->DynamoDB migration story is instead carried by the zone-e subtitle, d2's 'replaces SQLite / removes single-writer limit' detail lines, and the DPI 2 honesty footnote. (Three overlong DPI 2 titles — d3, d5, d6 — were trimmed to fit the uniform card width, with the trimmed phrasing moved into their wrapping sub lines; the engine wraps sub/detail but not title. The DPI 1 'trunk' edge E11 was routed through the gutter below its target panel row rather than below the whole body, so it no longer crosses the new row-2 band; the D3 pipeline label uses a new 'rowtop-gutter' placement so it does not straddle the zone-e/zone-f seam.) Canvas dimensions printed: 3136 x 1908 (col width 262, card height 234, rows 3, cols 6); the DPI 1 canvas stays 2702 x 1420. Verification: node scripts/gen-diagram-dpi2.js --dry-run -> '0 collisions', exit 0, 16 nodes; node --test scripts/gen-diagram.test.js -> pass 11 / fail 0; node scripts/gen-diagram.js --dry-run -> '0 collisions', nodes 10, exit 0; npm run gen:diagram:dpi2 wrote OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg (34385 bytes) and .png (1100320 bytes). DPI 1 OUTPUT confirmed UNTOUCHED: Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram.svg (25059 bytes) and .png (836603 bytes) retain LastWriteTime 01-10-2026 14:45:42 and byte sizes unchanged before and after the DPI 2 run. Added 'gen:diagram:dpi2' to package.json immediately after 'gen:diagram' without reordering other scripts. No packages/ source modified; dev servers not touched; no .env edits.
